description: This file defines shared configuration functions and parameter sets for benchmarking various neural network operations using the operator_benchmark framework. It includes functions to filter configurations based on device type and multiple predefined configuration lists for convolutional, linear, and embedding operations.

methods.name: remove_cuda
methods.description: Filters out configurations that specify 'cuda' as the device.

methods.name: remove_cpu
methods.description: Filters out configurations that specify 'cpu' as the device.
